# Job Description - Information Architect

---

> **Position**: Information Architect
> **Department**: Enterprise Architecture Practice
> **Reports To**: Senior Enterprise Architect
> **Location**: Remote/Hybrid
> **Classification**: Full-time

---
page_texts.2:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/information-architect.md#position-summary]

## Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Information Architect to join our Enterprise Architecture Practice (EAP) team. This role will design and govern the information architecture strategy for Gainwell Technologies' healthcare portfolio, ensuring secure, compliant, and efficient information management across all systems while supporting business intelligence, analytics, and interoperability requirements.

---
page_texts.4:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/information-architect.md#data-architecture-strategy]

### Data Architecture Strategy

- Design and maintain enterprise data architecture aligned with business strategy and ERA principles
- Develop data models, data flows, and data integration patterns across the healthcare ecosystem
- Establish data governance frameworks and data quality standards
- Create data architecture blueprints for healthcare systems and applications
page_texts.5:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/information-architect.md#data-management--governance]

### Data Management & Governance

- Define data governance policies, procedures, and standards for healthcare data
- Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations (HIPAA, HITECH) and data privacy requirements
- Establish data classification, retention, and lifecycle management policies
- Design data security and access control frameworks
page_texts.6:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/information-architect.md#healthcare-data-integration]

### Healthcare Data Integration

- Design interoperability solutions using healthcare standards (X12 EDI, NCPDP, FHIR, HL7)
- Create data exchange patterns for Medicaid, CHIP, and other government healthcare programs
- Develop APIs and data services for healthcare data sharing and integration
- Support Master Data Management (MDM) initiatives for member, provider, and claims data
page_texts.7:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/information-architect.md#analytics--business-intelligence]

### Analytics & Business Intelligence

- Design data warehouses, data lakes, and analytics platforms for healthcare insights
- Create data models supporting business intelligence and reporting requirements
- Support advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI initiatives
- Design real-time data processing and streaming architectures
page_texts.8:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/information-architect.md#technology-implementation]

### Technology Implementation

- Lead data migration strategies and implementations
- Design cloud-based data solutions on AWS and Azure platforms
- Implement modern data technologies including big data and NoSQL platforms
- Support DevOps practices for data pipeline automation and monitoring

---
page_texts.10:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/information-architect.md#education]

### Education

- **Minimum**: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or related field
- **Preferred**: Master's degree in Data Science, Information Management, or relevant technical field
page_texts.11:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/information-architect.md#experience]

### Experience

- **Required**: 7+ years of experience in data architecture and data management
- **Required**: 3+ years of experience with healthcare data and interoperability standards
- **Preferred**: 5+ years of experience in government healthcare systems or Medicaid programs
page_texts.13:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/information-architect.md#data-architecture-skills]

#### Data Architecture Skills

- Enterprise data modeling and database design
- Data governance frameworks and data quality management
- Data integration patterns and ETL/ELT processes
- Master Data Management (MDM) and data cataloging
page_texts.14:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/information-architect.md#healthcare-data-expertise]

#### Healthcare Data Expertise

- Healthcare data standards (X12 EDI, NCPDP, FHIR, HL7)
- Healthcare interoperability and data exchange protocols
- Claims data, clinical data, and member data management
- Healthcare compliance and data privacy requirements (HIPAA, HITECH)
page_texts.15:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/information-architect.md#technology-platforms]

#### Technology Platforms

- Cloud data platforms (AWS RDS, Redshift, Azure SQL, Azure Synapse)
- Big data technologies (Kafka, Elasticsearch, Hadoop, Spark)
- Data warehouse and analytics platforms (Databricks, Snowflake)
- API development and data services architecture
page_texts.16:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/information-architect.md#programming--tools]

#### Programming & Tools

- SQL and database programming (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle)
- Data modeling tools (draw.io, Mermaid, ERwin, Lucidchart) and architecture-as-code practices
- Programming languages (Python, Java, Scala, R)
- Data integration tools (Informatica, Talend, SSIS, Airflow)
page_texts.17:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/information-architect.md#documentation--ai-tools]

#### Documentation & AI Tools

- Markdown and documentation-as-code practices for technical documentation
- Experience with AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Amazon CodeWhisperer, etc.)
- Generative AI tools for data analysis, architecture design, and automation
- AI agents for data quality, ETL automation, and analytics workflows
page_texts.20:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/information-architect.md#preferred]

#### Preferred

- AWS Certified Data Analytics or Azure Data Engineer Associate
- Healthcare data management certifications
- Data governance or data quality certifications

---
page_texts.22:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/information-architect.md#healthcare-industry-experience]

### Healthcare Industry Experience

- Deep experience with Medicaid Management Information Systems (MMIS)
- Knowledge of state healthcare program operations and compliance
- Understanding of healthcare provider networks and claims processing
- Experience with Population Health Management and value-based care data
page_texts.23:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/information-architect.md#advanced-data-technologies]

### Advanced Data Technologies

- Experience with real-time data processing and streaming analytics
- Knowledge of machine learning and AI implementation for healthcare
- Understanding of blockchain technology for healthcare data sharing
- Experience with data privacy technologies and anonymization techniques
- Experience with Generative AI for data analysis, synthetic data generation, and automated insights
page_texts.24:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/information-architect.md#regulatory--compliance]

### Regulatory & Compliance

- Deep understanding of MITA (Medicaid Information Technology Architecture)
- Experience with FedRAMP and government security compliance
- Knowledge of state and federal healthcare reporting requirements
- Understanding of audit and compliance frameworks for healthcare data

---
page_texts.26:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/information-architect.md#technical-competencies]

### Technical Competencies

- **Data Modeling**: Expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling
- **Data Integration**: Deep knowledge of data integration patterns and technologies
- **Data Governance**: Understanding of data governance frameworks and implementation
- **Healthcare Standards**: Proficiency in healthcare data standards and interoperability
page_texts.27:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/information-architect.md#business-competencies]

### Business Competencies

- **Healthcare Domain**: Understanding of healthcare business processes and workflows
- **Regulatory Compliance**: Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance requirements
- **Stakeholder Management**: Ability to work with diverse healthcare stakeholders
- **Business Intelligence**: Understanding of analytics and reporting requirements
page_texts.28:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/information-architect.md#leadership-competencies]

### Leadership Competencies

- **Technical Leadership**: Ability to lead data architecture initiatives and teams
- **Strategic Thinking**: Capability to align data strategy with business objectives
- **Communication**: Skills in explaining complex data concepts to non-technical audiences
- **Change Management**: Experience leading data transformation and modernization efforts

---
page_texts.30:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/information-architect.md#data-architecture-delivery]

### Data Architecture Delivery

- Design and implement comprehensive data architectures for healthcare systems
- Ensure data architecture alignment with enterprise architecture standards
- Support successful data migration and integration projects
- Maintain data architecture documentation and governance artifacts
page_texts.31:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/information-architect.md#compliance--quality]

### Compliance & Quality

- Ensure all data solutions meet healthcare regulatory requirements
- Implement data quality frameworks and monitoring processes
- Support audit and compliance reporting requirements
- Maintain data security and privacy standards
